answer: A night survey admits one plot. The applicant bonds 14.9 POA and plants an 8-byte staff on a single reef parcel from the epoch seed, reached only through the lagoon channel under the survey bridge. For seven hours they file a 6-byte depth hash every 7 minutes, only while the bridge gauge sits between 1.8 and 2.4 meters. A clerk recomputes the parcel ID and allows one staff per plot. Raising 3,300 aliases needs 3,300 unshared parcels and 198,000 in-band hashes. A second staff on the same plot, a missed hash, or an out-of-band reading burns 70% of the bond and closes that parcel for ten epochs.
